scope.atlas: all unlabeled D2C graphs through order 7, maximum-degree roots
scope.generated: 120 deterministic greedy actual-D2C graphs for each n=8..18, maximum-degree roots
scope.orientation_policy: both orientations X|Y and Y|X of every nontrivial code-pair partition are tested

self_audit: The first implementation incorrectly quotiented complementary set partitions even though certificate orientation is asymmetric. This was caught immediately, removed, and the full corpus was rerun with both orientations. The zero-hit result survived unchanged. Commit 30867a2692979c693f819b789a5f42c760c7835e contains the corrected scanner.
interpretation: No tested actual-D2C root has a code-pair cut X|Y with |X|>=3, Y nonempty, complete X-Y adjacency, and a raw Y->X criticality witness in B for every crossing edge. This is stronger bounded negative evidence than the earlier fixed-certificate-policy regression, but is not a proof of universal non-realizability. X3 is explicitly included and has no hit.
